dimensions.summary: Candidate identity, facts, provider detection, ontology, graph, generation, quality, lineage, n-ary and query-cache contracts are schema compiled and semantically admitted.
Provider manifests and FactBatch outputs cross one fail-closed admission boundary; authored declarations have no privileged graph mutation path.
Portable identities, alias collisions, unresolved candidates, evidence independence, competing facts, stale state, partial output, unknowns and unsupported zones remain explicit.
Canonical JSON and SHA-256 replay are deterministic and bounded against cycles, excessive nesting, non-JSON values and non-finite numbers.
Generated wire types and schemas survive a separately packed Shared and Graph install; governance, source, tests, scripts and local paths remain outside the artifact.
Graph conformance exceeds the enforced 90/90/90/85 line, statement, function and branch thresholds with adversarial behavior tests.

checks.evidence: Generated-contract drift, typecheck, lint, format, coverage, tests, build and isolated packed consumer pass.
Independent package quality, boundaries, mirrors, Shared adoption and Graph package gates pass.

remainingRisks: Linux evidence is local; Windows and macOS contract and packed-consumer lanes must be retained before approval.
G2 deterministic composition, proof policy and conflict resolution are not implemented.
Rust/native acceleration remains prohibited until TypeScript reference semantics exist and G6 measurements justify it.

approval.rule: A signed maintainer checkpoint plus retained Linux, Windows and macOS G1 conformance evidence authorizes G2 composition work.
